qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M8 hex screws on the transmission to engine connection?
What torque should I use for M10 hex screws in the transmission?
What is the torque specification for M8 Torx bolts?
How much torque should be applied to M10 Torx bolts?
What torque should be used for the reinforcement plate to transmission connection?
Which fastener type requires the highest torque specification in the transmission section?
qa_pairs.answer: M12 hex screws at 82 Nm (ft. lbs.)

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual covers these transmission torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 24-1 Automatic Transmission, subsection 24 00 Transmission in General
